jobPostingInfo.title: Private Credit Intern
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
This opportunity is to work with the Private Credit team based in London. The intern will provide analytical support as the team evaluates new investment opportunities.

Develop dynamic operating models, perform fundamental credit analysis, evaluate returns potential, optimal capital structure and exit scenarios. Interact with advisers and management teams during due diligence and monitor existing investments.

Requirements

Excellent academics in a related degree, such as Finance or Economics. Previous internship in a similar industry preferred. Excellent Excel, quantitative, credit, financial modelling, analytical, research and due diligence skills.
